why: One table of cases for the two copies of the rule 'a quantized V cache needs flash attention': caravan/common/kv_cache.py and static/js/kv-cache.js. `refused` is the V cache type the pair is refused for, or '' when llama.cpp starts with it.

cases.say: the pair the form of a new cell offered: q8_0 V cache, flash attention off
the form's own off is the string 0; a config written by hand may say false
off in the other spellings the config accepts
the type is read in any case and with stray spaces
every quantized type is refused, not only q8_0
flash attention on: any V cache type starts
flash attention off with a V cache of plain numbers starts: f16
flash attention off and no V cache type: llama.cpp's own f16
flash attention UNSTATED is no choice the operator made: llama.cpp decides, nothing is refused
...also when the key is missing altogether
only the V cache needs it: a quantized K cache with flash attention off starts
the draft model's cache types are saved but not passed: they refuse nothing
